title: Afghan Avalanche Rescue - Package, Short Version
description: Package made from "Afghan Avalanche Rescue" b-roll about coalition forces and Afghanistan security forces assisting Afghans injured in an avalanche in Parwan Province. Produced by Spc. Jennifer Dolsen
keywords: avalanche, Asif, Karen Kinne, Afghanistan, medical care

transcript.text: Afghan National Army and Coalition troops responded and organized rescue strategies for Afghans
affected by the avalanche in the area of Salang tunnel.
According to ISAF's Joint Command, more than 40 civilians were killed in the avalanche.
Hundreds of displaced civilians were safely rescued by the Afghan National Army Air Corps
Many were flown to Bogmerfield's Heath M. Craig Joint Theater Hospital and medically triage
based on the severity of their injuries.
I want to be able to have a facility like the American Hospital here because I want
the help from my people, for our country, for anyone that's injured or ill.
I mean, this is where it all comes together.
It's pretty awesome to be able to have trained them up so that they're able to start seeing
the big picture of how to respond to emergencies.
